narration_use: reference only when drafting; required units must be derivable from the public B2 inputs (table + intent)
file_naming: one G1 per input contract; B1/B3/B4/B5 need separate drafts
intent: To demonstrate that test-optional colleges attract more applicants than test-required colleges and that application volumes have increased over time.

units.meaning: The TEST-OPTIONAL series value increases over the labeled period from 1994 to 2010, starting at 1650.2643 and ending at 3600.0240, an increase of 1949.7597 (about 2.18 times the 1994 value).
accepted_routes: TEST-OPTIONAL rises from about 1,650 in 1994 to about 3,600 in 2010.
The TEST-OPTIONAL series has a clear upward trend over the period.
TEST-OPTIONAL more than doubles from 1994 to 2010, going from about 1,650 to about 3,600.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must show TEST-OPTIONAL values at 1994 and 2010 with the 2010 value higher and the series following an overall upward path.
units.temporal_anchor: First more students apply / more will
units.reviewer_question: Should the upward TEST-OPTIONAL trend be mandatory, or is the cross-entity comparison alone enough?

units.meaning: The TEST-REQUIRED series value also increases over the labeled period from 1994 to 2010, starting at 1550.2883 and ending at 3000.1682, an increase of 1449.8799 (about 1.94 times the 1994 value).
accepted_routes: TEST-REQUIRED rises from about 1,550 in 1994 to about 3,000 in 2010.
The TEST-REQUIRED series has an upward trend over the period.
TEST-REQUIRED nearly doubles from 1994 to 2010, going from about 1,550 to about 3,000.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must show TEST-REQUIRED values at 1994 and 2010 with the 2010 value higher and the series following an overall upward path.
units.temporal_anchor: First more students apply / more will
units.reviewer_question: Should the upward TEST-REQUIRED trend be mandatory, or can the clip focus on TEST-OPTIONAL only?

units.meaning: At each labeled year with both series, TEST-OPTIONAL is higher than TEST-REQUIRED: 1994 1650.2643 > 1550.2883; 1998 1950.1922 > 1750.2403; 2002 2299.8799 > 1899.9760; 2010 3600.0240 > 3000.1682.
accepted_routes: At all labeled years, TEST-OPTIONAL is above TEST-REQUIRED.
TEST-OPTIONAL is consistently higher than TEST-REQUIRED, e.g. 2010: about 3,600 vs about 3,000.
The two series never cross; TEST-OPTIONAL exceeds TEST-REQUIRED at each comparable time point.
units.visual_evidence_rule: Both series must be shown at the same labeled years, and TEST-OPTIONAL must be visibly above TEST-REQUIRED at each of those years.
units.temporal_anchor: when universities make it easier to do so, whether by using the common application or removing requirements like test scores, more will
units.reviewer_question: Should the clip be required to show TEST-OPTIONAL above TEST-REQUIRED at multiple labeled years, or is one endpoint comparison enough?

units.meaning: At 2010, TEST-OPTIONAL exceeds TEST-REQUIRED by 599.8558 value units and is about 1.20 times TEST-REQUIRED (3600.0240 vs 3000.1682).
accepted_routes: By 2010, TEST-OPTIONAL leads TEST-REQUIRED by about 600 value units.
In 2010, TEST-OPTIONAL is about 1.2 times TEST-REQUIRED.
The 2010 endpoint gap is roughly 600 in favor of TEST-OPTIONAL.
units.visual_evidence_rule: At the 2010 point, the TEST-OPTIONAL value must be shown above the TEST-REQUIRED value, with the gap or ratio made legible.
units.temporal_anchor: more will / removing requirements like test scores
units.reviewer_question: Is the 2010 optional–required lead by about 600, or about 1.2 times, a required endpoint detail or optional emphasis?

units.meaning: The TEST-OPTIONAL advantage over TEST-REQUIRED widens from 1994 to 2010: the gap rises from 99.976 (1650.2643 - 1550.2883) to 599.8558 (3600.0240 - 3000.1682).
accepted_routes: The optional–required gap widens over time, from about 100 in 1994 to about 600 in 2010.
TEST-OPTIONAL pulls further ahead of TEST-REQUIRED between 1994 and 2010.
The difference between the two series grows across the labeled period.
units.visual_evidence_rule: The chart must show the optional–required gap at 1994 and 2010, with the 2010 gap visibly larger than the 1994 gap.
units.temporal_anchor: more will / when universities make it easier to do so
units.reviewer_question: Is the widening gap an expected semantic beat, or optional extra detail beyond the required trend and comparison?

optional_valid: TEST-OPTIONAL reaches its highest labeled value at 2010 (3600.0240).
TEST-REQUIRED reaches its highest labeled value at 2010 (3000.1682).
The optional series has a larger total gain than the required series from 1994 to 2010 (1949.7597 vs 1449.8799).
unsupported_to_avoid: Do not claim that making tests optional caused the increase; the table and narration do not establish causation.
Do not say schools accepted more applicants; the narration explicitly says they are not accepting more.
Do not treat relative_value as a percentage or as an absolute applicant count.
Do not cite values outside the table or extrapolate beyond 2010.
Do not describe chart type, colors, axis ticks, or pixel positions as semantic units.
notes: All cited numbers are from the table's value column; relative_value is not used as a percentage. Causal explanations for the increase are not supported by the table.
weight_mode_note: every unit gets 1/n so coverage is a plain share; weight_template is kept for per-type analysis only
